editorial:
Ever wonder what really happened behind one of the biggest scandals in sports history? This movie pulls you right into the wild world of competitive figure skating, following Tonya Harding as she fights her way up from a tough childhood to the top of the U.S. Championships. You meet her pushy mother, her abusive husband, and a cast of characters who all tell their own version of the truth. The tone swings between dark comedy and raw drama, so you never quite know whether to laugh or cringe. It feels like a true crime story told by unreliable narrators, and that energy keeps you hooked from the first scene.

Margot Robbie delivers a powerhouse performance that makes you feel every bruise and every triumph, while the supporting cast keeps the chaos grounded. The pacing is snappy, the soundtrack is fantastic, and the fourth-wall breaks add a fun, fresh twist. On the downside, the violence and language can be heavy, and some viewers may find the humor too dark. If you enjoy character-driven stories with bite, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: The final scenes show Tonya's life after the scandal. She is banned from skating for life, tries boxing, and struggles to move on. The twist is that the film never fully confirms who planned the attack on Nancy Kerrigan, leaving you to decide who to believe. Tonya insists she only knew after the fact, and the movie ends with her skating again in a small rink, chasing a dream that will never fully return.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime stories, dark comedy, and character-driven dramas.
